sentences.text: The Free State of Saxony -LRB- der Freistaat Sachsen -LSB- ˈfʁaɪ̯ʃtaːt ˈzaksn̩ -RSB- Swobodny stat Sakska -RRB- is a landlocked federal state of Germany , bordering the federal states of Brandenburg , Saxony Anhalt , Thuringia , and Bavaria , as well as the countries of Poland -LRB- Lower Silesian and Lubusz Voivodeships -RRB- and the Czech Republic -LRB- Karlovy Vary , Liberec and Ústí nad Labem Regions -RRB- .	state	States of Germany	Germany	Germany	Brandenburg	Brandenburg	Saxony Anhalt	Saxony Anhalt	Thuringia	Thuringia	Bavaria	Bavaria	countries	countries	Poland	Poland	Lower Silesian	Lower Silesian Voivodeship	Czech Republic	Czech Republic	Karlovy Vary	Karlovy Vary Region	Liberec	Liberec Region
Its capital is Dresden , and its largest city is Leipzig .	Dresden	Dresden	Leipzig	Leipzig
Saxony is the tenth largest of Germany 's sixteen states , with an area of 18,413 km2 , and the sixth most populous , with 4 million people .	Germany	Germany
Located in the middle of a large , formerly all German-speaking part of Europe , the history of the state of Saxony spans more than a millennium .	state	States of Germany

It has been a medieval duchy , an electorate of the Holy Roman Empire , a kingdom , and twice a republic .	duchy	Duchy of Saxony	electorate	Electorate of Saxony	Holy Roman Empire	Holy Roman Empire	kingdom	Kingdom of Saxony
The area of the modern state of Saxony should not be confused with Old Saxony , the area inhabited by Saxons .	state	States of Germany	Old Saxony	Old Saxony	Saxons	Saxons

Old Saxony corresponds approximately to the modern German states of Lower Saxony , Saxony-Anhalt and the Westphalian part of North Rhine-Westphalia .	Old Saxony	Old Saxony	Lower Saxony	Lower Saxony	Saxony-Anhalt	Saxony-Anhalt	North Rhine-Westphalia	North Rhine-Westphalia
